Cinematic fantasy concept art, readable silhouette, no visible text, no UI, no watermark. Do not include the Strixwolf Mother, strixwolf pups, wolves, owlbears, or animal companions.
Personality: Not malice, momentum. A duty that outlived the man and a debt that kept the bones. Somewhere under the patrol loop is someone who wants, very quietly, for the post to finally fall.
Wants: Hold the post because the old order is the only command still left.
Fears: No fear as a tactical creature; the person-layer feared leaving loved ones with the debt.
Secrets: Each skeleton still carries a trace of trade, family, and grievance if the GM gives it a moment.
Body Language: Checks exits and cargo before glory. Fear makes the violence practical rather than theatrical.
Sample Dialogue: Permit... expired. Post... must hold. Debt remains. Door remains.
